entries.body: Stages1-3 in invoice/core.py: validation (empty, qty pos int non-bool, price>=0); bulk qty>=100 line*0.90; no line rounding; exact sub, disc (gold .05 silver .02), tax (NZ .15 AU .10 US 0 else .12) on sub-disc; each rounded half-even via _e; total=rs-rd+rt. format_money still NotImplemented. Check test result then advance to stage 4.
